title: Cloud Architect – Data Mesh, AI Labs on Azure
description:
Luxoft is partnering with a major vehicle manufacturer to design and implement a secure cloud foundation platform for workloads and business applications. The role focuses on governance, data mesh, AI- ready datasets, and scalable architectures within a collaborative agile environment.

You will lead integration projects, design semantic layers, and drive DevOps practices including infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and automated deployments to enable AI data workflows.

Support integration between Collibra and Microsoft Fabric and evaluate Fabric capabilities. Manage Fabric-native catalog, discovery, metadata, and business glossary. Lead data product discovery, governance, and data protection policies. Design cloud components such as OneLake, data mesh, and semantic layers. Develop cloud architectures emphasizing security, scalability, and compliance. Must have hands-on experience with Python and cloud IaaS architectures. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure services and DevOps practices. Familiarity with Data Fabric concepts and data governance fundamentals.

title: Fire Sprinkler Apprenticeship Training Provided
description:
Job Summary
UV Fire Protection Systems, Inc. is seeking motivated and reliable individuals to join our team as a Fire Sprinkler Apprentice. This position is ideal for candidates looking to start a career in the fire protection industry, as well as individuals with prior experience in fire sprinkler installation or pipefitting.

In this role, you will assist with the installation, maintenance, and repair of fire sprinkler systems in schools, residential, and commercial buildings. You will work alongside experienced foremen and pipefitters while learning to read blueprints, plan installations, and prepare piping systems. The ideal candidate is hardworking, detail-oriented, safety-conscious, and eager to learn a skilled trade.

Key Work Areas
Projects are located throughout Central Florida:
  • Miami Dade County
  • Broward County County
  • Palm Beach County
  • Monroe County
  • Collier County
  • Martin County
  • St. Luice County
Frequent local travel to job sites is required.

Responsibilities
  • Assist with coordination and installation of overhead fire sprinkler systems
  • Learn to read and comprehend blueprints, specifications, and project schedules
  • Measure, cut, assemble, lubricate, and install piping systems
  • Use a variety of hand and power tools safely and efficiently
  • Support testing of system functionality and assist with troubleshooting leaks or malfunctions
  • Participate in weekly job site safety meetings
  • Follow all OSHA and company safety guidelines
  • Maintain clean and organized work areas
  • Work collaboratively with other construction professionals to complete projects
  • Travel to various local job sites as assigned
Qualifications
  • No experience required — training provided
  • Previous experience in fire sprinkler installation, pipefitting, plumbing, or construction is a plus
  • Ability to read blueprints (or willingness to learn)
  • Strong mathematical and problem-solving skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Knowledge of safety standards (OSHA) preferred
  • Ability to pass a full background check (required for Public Schools, Federal, and Government Buildings)
  • Must be physically capable of performing trade work, including:
    • Occasional lifting up to 50 lbs
    • Frequent lifting up to 25 lbs
    • Standing and walking for extended periods
  • Willingness to work overtime when required
  • Willingness to work overnight and weekends.
What We Offer
  • On-the-job training and career advancement opportunities
  • Competitive pay based on experience
  • Opportunity to grow within a stable and expanding company
  • Hands-on experience in a skilled trade with long-term career potential
If you are dependable, safety-focused, and ready to build a career in the fire protection industry, we encourage you to apply.

title: VP Enterprise Transformation
description:
A Day in the Life:

Hertz is undertaking a significant enterprise transformation to reshape its business model, operating structure, cost base, and capabilities. This work spans multiple business platforms, functions, and geographies, with substantial financial implications and complex organizational, operational, and technology dependencies.

The VP, Enterprise Transformation will lead the enterprise transformation team within the Strategy & Execution Office in the Office of the CEO. This leader is responsible for shaping and orchestrating Hertz's most consequential transformation initiatives, establishing execution accountability, and ensuring strategic decisions translate into measurable financial and operational results.

The role requires demonstrated experience leading large-scale business transformations involving operating-model redesign, organizational restructuring, cost transformation, business integration or separation, and complex cross-functional execution.

Working directly with executive sponsors, functional leaders, and external advisors, the VP will establish integrated transformation plans, drive critical decisions, and ensure the organization captures the intended value. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring the strategic judgment of a senior advisor, the financial discipline of a value-creation leader, and the execution capabilities of an experienced operator.

What You’ll Do:

Lead Enterprise Transformation

• Lead the end-to-end orchestration of complex, multi-year transformation programs spanning business platforms, functions, and geographies.

• Shape transformation strategy and architecture, including workstream design, sequencing, critical paths, decision rights, and execution governance.

• Integrate concurrent initiatives involving business-model changes, organizational restructuring, technology, operational capabilities, and strategic transactions.

• Anticipate and resolve systemic risks, cross-functional dependencies, resource constraints, and competing enterprise priorities.

• Balance transformation pace and financial value capture with business continuity and operational risk.

Drive Operating Model & Organizational Transformation

• Lead current-state assessments and future-state operating-model design, including organizational structures, functional responsibilities, decision rights, capabilities, and ways of working.

• Direct cost-base redesign, including functional cost envelopes, organizational sizing, spans and layers, and restructuring opportunities.

• Oversee transition planning across organizational, operational, and technology changes, ensuring sequencing aligns with the future business model.

• Identify capability gaps, stranded-cost exposure, and structural barriers to achieving target economics.

• Partner with HR and functional leadership to address talent implications, organizational readiness, and change adoption.

Lead Integration, Separation & Strategic Transactions

• Lead or oversee complex post-merger integrations, business separations, carve-outs, and transaction-related restructuring.

• Direct planning across transaction perimeters, functional entanglements, Day 1 readiness, transition services agreements (TSAs), and post-close stabilization.

• Coordinate Finance, Legal, Tax, HR, Technology, Operations, and external advisors to resolve interdependencies and maintain transaction readiness.

• Oversee synergy realization, standalone operating requirements, stranded-cost mitigation, transition costs, and integration or separation economics.

• Establish repeatable execution capabilities for future transactions and business transitions.

Drive Financial Value Realization

• Establish transformation value targets, financial baselines, and clear accountability for benefits realization.

• Partner with Finance to develop and challenge integrated financial models, business cases, cost bridges, and investment requirements.

• Evaluate enterprise-value tradeoffs involving capital allocation, timing, transition costs, operating performance, and execution risk.

• Maintain a rigorous value-capture process that links initiative commitments to realized EBITDA, cash flow, revenue, and cost improvements.

• Identify value leakage, challenge underperforming initiatives, and drive corrective interventions.

Accelerate Executive Decision-Making

• Lead transformation governance, executive steering committees, and decision-oriented performance reviews.

• Structure complex strategic and operational issues into clear alternatives, quantified tradeoffs, and actionable recommendations.

• Anticipate decisions required along the critical path and ensure leadership has the information and accountability needed to act.

• Provide objective assessments of transformation progress, financial exposure, organizational constraints, and corrective actions.

Build Transformation Capability

• Lead and develop a high-performing team of Transformation Leads and Analysts.

• Establish transformation methodologies, performance infrastructure, execution standards, and management cadences.

• Manage external consulting and advisory relationships, ensuring clear deliverables, effective knowledge transfer, and internal ownership.

• Build the capabilities required for Hertz to independently execute future transformations, integrations, separations, and restructuring initiatives.

What We’re Looking For:

Experience

• 12+ years of progressive experience in enterprise transformation, management consulting, corporate strategy, operations, or transaction-related transformation required.

• Demonstrated personal leadership of large-scale, multi-workstream transformations with material financial impact, including direct accountability for implementation and outcomes.

• Experience designing and implementing future-state operating models, organizational restructuring, cost-base transformation, or business-model reinvention.

• Experience leading complex integration, separation, carve-out, or comparable enterprise restructuring initiatives.

• Strong understanding of transformation economics, including synergies, stranded costs, standalone operating requirements, transition costs, and value realization.

• Advanced financial acumen, including integrated financial modeling, business-case development, and enterprise-value tradeoffs.

• Proven ability to influence C-suite executives, challenge assumptions, navigate organizational resistance, and drive decisions in high-stakes environments.

• Experience leading high-performing teams and managing external advisors.

Skills & Competencies

• Enterprise-first orientation that prioritizes enterprise economics over functional interests.

• Ability to shape strategy and drive implementation with equal effectiveness.

• Relentless focus on measurable financial and operational outcomes.

• Ability to constructively challenge senior leaders, assumptions, and established practices.

• Sound judgment and decisiveness under ambiguity and pressure.

• Proactive problem-solving, credibility, rigor, and high accountability.

Preferred

• Former senior leader within a top-tier strategy consulting firm (McKinsey, Bain, BCG), transformation practice, or enterprise value-creation function.

• Experience leading a Transformation Office, Integration Management Office (IMO), or Separation Management Office (SMO).

• Direct experience with M&A diligence, transaction planning, Day 1 readiness, TSA management, and post-close stabilization.

• Track record of delivering significant EBITDA improvement, cash generation, cost restructuring, or enterprise-value creation.

• Experience in asset-intensive, multi-geography, consumer-facing, or operationally complex businesses.

What Success Looks Like:

• Enterprise transformation initiatives deliver material, measurable financial and operational value.

• Complex operating-model changes, organizational transitions, and strategic transactions are executed with disciplined sequencing and minimal business disruption.

• Critical dependencies, structural barriers, and value-capture risks are resolved before they compromise outcomes.

• Executive leadership has clear visibility into transformation economics, execution health, and decisions required.

• Hertz develops a stronger internal capability to lead complex enterprise transformations.

What’s In It For You:

• Salary Starts at $300,000.

Up to 40% off the base rate of any standard Hertz Rental

• Medical, Dental & Vision plan options

• Retirement programs, including 401(k) employer matching

• Paid Parental Leave & Adoption Assistance

• Employee Assistance Program for employees & family

• Educational Reimbursement & Discounts

• Voluntary Insurance Programs - Pet, Legal/Identity Theft, Critical Illness

• Perks & Discounts - Theme Park Tickets, Gym Discounts & more

Tools and uniforms: Company will provide all power tools. Employee is required to provide all hand tools.

Experience and qualifications

  • Hands-on building fire sprinkler installation experience is required; Four or more years is preferred. You must already be able to perform the core installation tasks below with normal field supervision. This is not an entry-level training position.
  • Read sprinkler installation drawings and use a tape measure to lay out assigned piping; measure, cut, thread, and groove steel pipe using the appropriate equipment.

  • Install overhead fire sprinkler piping and components according to approved drawings, project requirements, and supervisor direction.

Eligible employees receive 40 hours of paid personal time off and five company-designated paid holidays after 12 months of employment. A 401(k) retirement plan is available subject to its eligibility and enrollment rules. Benefit details and effective dates will be explained before you accept an offer.

Working conditions

This is an active construction position involving standing and walking for much of the day, overhead work, ladders or lifts, and confined-space work where assigned and properly authorized. Essential duties include occasional lifting up to 50 pounds and frequent lifting up to 25 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

We will explain the reporting location, expected schedule, travel arrangements, compensation, and benefit eligibility before you accept an offer so you can decide whether the position works for you.

Apply

Apply with your contact information and a short description of your sprinkler installation experience. A resume is welcome but not required. Include the systems you have worked on and the tasks you performed yourself. Qualified applicants will be contacted for a brief work-arrangement discussion and installation-skills interview.

title: Senior Director Enterprise Transformation
description:
A Day in the Life:

Hertz is undertaking a significant enterprise transformation to reshape its business model, operating structure, cost base, and capabilities. Execution requires coordinating complex initiatives across business platforms, functions, and geographies while maintaining ongoing operational performance.

The Enterprise Transformation Sr Director sits within the Strategy & Execution Office in the Office of the CEO and owns the end-to-end orchestration of enterprise-critical transformation initiatives.

The role translates complex strategic objectives into executable plans and measurable outcomes. Initiatives may involve operating-model redesign, organizational restructuring, cost transformation, capability building, business integration or separation, and significant cross-functional dependencies.

The Sr Director independently structures ambiguous problems, develops business cases, establishes integrated workplans, mobilizes functional leaders, resolves execution barriers, challenges assumptions, and manages initiatives through implementation and value realization.

What You’ll Do:

Lead Enterprise Transformation Initiatives

• Own end-to-end execution of complex transformation initiatives, from strategic problem definition and business-case development through implementation and value realization.

• Develop integrated transformation plans covering workstream scope, milestones, critical paths, dependencies, decision points, accountable owners, and financial outcomes.

• Mobilize cross-functional teams across business platforms and corporate functions, often without direct reporting authority.

• Proactively identify and resolve execution barriers, resource constraints, and competing priorities.

• Coordinate complex transitions while maintaining business continuity and operational performance.

Drive Operating Model & Organizational Change

• Conduct current-state assessments and develop future-state operating-model recommendations, including organizational structures, capabilities, decision rights, and processes.

• Translate strategic designs into executable transition plans covering organizational changes, technology, resources, and new ways of working.

• Support cost-base redesign, functional cost analysis, organizational sizing, and restructuring initiatives.

• Identify capability gaps, stranded-cost exposure, and operational dependencies that affect transformation economics.

• Partner with functional leaders to implement new operating models and establish sustainable performance mechanisms.

Support Integration, Separation & Restructuring

• Lead or support complex workstreams associated with post-merger integration, business separation, carve-outs, and restructuring.

• Develop functional transition plans, Day 1 readiness requirements, implementation milestones, and post-close stabilization plans.

• Identify operational, financial, technology, organizational, and contractual entanglements requiring resolution.

• Coordinate functional teams and external advisors on transition services, systems migration, organizational changes, and business continuity.

• Support synergy capture, stranded-cost mitigation, standalone cost analysis, and transaction-related value realization.

Drive Financial Value Realization

• Develop and pressure-test transformation business cases, financial assumptions, and investment requirements.

• Establish financial baselines and quantify expected EBITDA, cash flow, cost, revenue, and operational impacts.

• Partner with Finance and business owners to track financial commitments through realized performance.

• Evaluate tradeoffs involving sequencing, capital requirements, transition costs, operational risk, and enterprise value.

• Identify value leakage and develop corrective actions when expected benefits are at risk.

Accelerate Decisions & Execution

• Apply hypothesis-driven problem-solving to complex strategic and operational challenges.

• Structure executive decisions through clear alternatives, quantified tradeoffs, and recommendations.

• Anticipate critical-path risks and resolve cross-functional dependencies before they impede execution.

• Challenge assumptions and drive stakeholder alignment when organizational friction threatens outcomes.

• Develop concise, decision-oriented executive materials and transformation reviews.

Build Transformation Discipline

• Establish initiative-level governance, performance measures, ownership, and execution standards.

• Maintain integrated visibility into workstream progress, dependencies, financial benefits, and execution risks.

• Coordinate internal teams and external advisors to ensure effective implementation and knowledge transfer.

• Develop repeatable transformation tools, playbooks, and operating mechanisms that strengthen internal execution capabilities.

What We’re Looking For:

Experience

• 12+ years of experience in management consulting, enterprise transformation, corporate strategy, operations, or transaction-related transformation.

• Demonstrated ownership of complex, cross-functional transformation workstreams from strategy through implementation, with measurable financial or operational impact.

• Experience structuring ambiguous business problems, developing strategic recommendations, and translating them into executable plans.

• Strong financial modeling and analytical capabilities, including business cases, cost structures, scenario analysis, and value-capture tracking.

• Experience with operating-model redesign, organizational restructuring, cost transformation, or major operational change.

• Ability to manage complex critical paths, functional interdependencies, and competing stakeholder priorities.

• Proven ability to influence senior executives and drive accountability without direct authority.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong executive communication, structured problem-solving, and judgment under pressure.

• Ownership mentality and accountability from problem definition through value realization.

• Ability to bring clarity and direction to complex, ambiguous problems.

• Financial accountability and understanding of the economics behind transformation decisions.

• Operator mindset with the ability to move from strategic analysis into implementation detail.

• Influence without authority, bias toward action, adaptability, and resilience.

Preferred

• Former engagement manager or project leader at McKinsey, Bain, BCG, or equivalent strategy consulting or transformation experience.

• Experience with post-merger integration, business separation, carve-outs, restructuring, or transaction-related transformation.

• Familiarity with Day 1 readiness, functional separation planning, TSA requirements, and post-close transition management.

• Experience with synergy capture, stranded-cost analysis, organizational cost restructuring, or value-creation programs.

• Background in asset-intensive, multi-geography, consumer-facing, or operationally complex businesses.

• Experience leveraging AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve transformation effectiveness.

What Success Looks Like:

• Complex transformation initiatives achieve measurable financial and operational outcomes.

• Cross-functional teams execute against integrated plans with clear ownership and accountability.

• Critical dependencies, organizational constraints, and execution risks are proactively resolved.

• Operating-model changes and business transitions are implemented without material disruption.

• Executive decisions are accelerated through rigorous analysis and clear recommendations.

  • Working knowledge of AWS networking and access controls, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, and IAM.
  • Understanding of Active Directory, DNS, Group Policy, TCP/IP networking, and server storage.
  • Experience supporting server migrations, infrastructure transitions, or datacenter consolidation initiatives.
  • Ability to troubleshoot issues across operating systems, virtualization, networking, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS Application Migration Service or similar migration tools.
  • PowerShell scripting and automation skills.
  • Familiarity with backup, recovery, monitoring, and security tools across on-premises and AWS environments.

Success Measures
  • Assigned workloads are migrated and validated within approved migration windows.
  • Post-migration issues are resolved promptly, with minimal disruption to business operations.
  • Migration runbooks and operational documentation are complete and accurate.
  • Migrated systems are successfully transitioned to ongoing support teams.

Position Overview

Stealth Solutions is seeking a senior individual contributor with a rare combination of Salesforce development depth, data architecture skills, MuleSoft integration experience, and hands-on Data 360 expertise. This role supports Dept. of Commerce – Federal Grants Programs. The role requires someone who builds: designing Salesforce data models, writing migration scripts, configuring MuleSoft integrations, and standing up Data 360 semantic models. The ideal candidate has spent years as a Salesforce developer (Apex, LWC, Flows) and has evolved into data-centric work: object model design, large-scale data migration, integration architecture, and analytics enablement through Data 360. We need someone who can think across the full data lifecycle from source system profiling through Salesforce object modeling to semantic layer definition - and who can personally execute each step.

Core Responsibilities

  • Salesforce Data Modeling & Architecture: Design, extend, and optimize Salesforce data models including custom objects, relationships (master-detail, lookup, junction), record types, field configurations, and data storage patterns. Ensure model decisions support compliance reporting, analytics, and downstream integration. Develop data warehousing blueprints and evaluate data reusability for additional analyses.
  • Data Migration: Lead end-to-end data migration activities: source system inventory and profiling, field-level mapping to Salesforce objects, ETL job development with cleansing and transformation rules, and phased migration sprints with iterative validation. Maintain legacy data access per agency retention policies.
  • MuleSoft Integration Development: Build and maintain API-led integrations using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. Implement System, Process, and Experience API layers connecting Salesforce with internal agency systems and external federal platforms. Write DataWeave transformations, configure CloudHub deployments, and implement error handling with retry mechanisms and automated alerting.
  • Data 360 & Semantic Layer: Configure and extend Salesforce Data 360 to build semantic models that enable natural-language querying and analytics. Define data relationships, business metrics, and calculated fields within the semantic layer. Support integration between Data 360, CRM Analytics, and Tableau Next.
  • Salesforce Application Development: Comfortable with declarative-first approach - build and maintain complex Flows and Flow Orchestrations as the primary automation mechanism, alongside Apex classes and triggers where custom code is warranted. Develop Lightning Web Components and SOQL/SOSL queries to support reporting and UI requirements
  • Data Quality & Governance: Own data quality for reporting and compliance data pipelines. Implement automated validation checks within integration flows and migration scripts. Produce Data Profiling Reports, Data Mapping Specifications, and post-migration reconciliation deliverables.
Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or related field.
  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of professional Salesforce development experience (Flows, Apex, LWC, SOQL), with at least 2 years focused on data architecture, data modeling, or large-scale data migration within Salesforce.
  • MuleSoft (Required): Prior project experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform including API design (RAML/OAS), Mule flows, DataWeave transformations, and CloudHub or Runtime Fabric deployment. Must demonstrate integration work delivered on a real engagement, not just training or certification.
  • Data 360 (Required): Hands-on project experience with Salesforce Data 360 (formerly Tableau CRM Data Prep or Data Cloud components). Must have configured semantic models, defined business metrics, or built data pipelines within Data 360 on a delivered project.
  • Salesforce Data Model Expertise: Deep understanding of Salesforce standard and custom objects, relationships, field types, record types, data storage limits, and data architecture best practices. Experience with Salesforce Data Loader, Bulk API, Metadata API, and data import/export patterns.
  • Certifications (Required): Salesforce Platform Developer I. At minimum one additional relevant certification (e.g., Platform Developer II, Data Architect, Integration Architect, MuleSoft Developer, or OmniStudio Developer).
  • Tools: Proficiency with SQL, Git/GitHub, JIRA, VS Code with Salesforce Extensions, and at least one data profiling or ETL tool.
  • Compliance: Must be eligible for Public Trust (Tier 2 / MBI) security clearance. U.S. citizenship or permanent residency required.
Preferred Expertise

  • Salesforce Data Architect or Integration Architect certification.
  • MuleSoft Certified Developer or MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect.
  • Experience with Salesforce Public Sector Solutions (PSS) Grants Management data model.
  • OmniStudio experience (DataRaptors, Integration Procedures) for data orchestration within Salesforce.
  • Experience with CRM Analytics (formerly Einstein Analytics) or Tableau Next.
  • Agentforce or Einstein AI experience - grounding data pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation, or AI data preparation.
  • FedRAMP compliance experience or prior work on federal government Salesforce contracts.

Flexible work from home options available.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Benefits:
  • 401(k) matching
  • 401(k)
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
Position Overview

Stealth Solutions is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to own release management, CI/CD, and platform administration for a large-scale Salesforce application supporting a U.S. Department of Commerce agency. The platform runs on Salesforce Government Cloud, and is built on Salesforce Public Sector Solutions with Experience Cloud, Service Cloud, and Omni Studio.

This is an ownership role. One engineer is accountable for everything that reaches production across several scrum teams working on a two-week sprint cadence. The application is configuration-first by design, so most of what moves through the pipeline is declarative metadata rather than custom code, and the release process has to handle Flow versioning, OmniStudio components, security and sharing changes, and Experience Cloud configuration alongside Apex and Lightning Web Components.

The current pipeline is built on GitHub Actions and is partially automated. There is clear room to close manual steps, tighten quality gates, and standardise promotion across teams. A migration to an enterprise Salesforce DevOps platform is planned, and the person in this role will lead that effort from design through cutover.

This position is designated Key Personnel by the Government and requires Contracting Officer approval before performance begins.

Core Responsibilities

  • Release Management: Own the release process end to end across multiple scrum teams. Maintain a forward release plan, run change review and go/no-go decisions, manage deployment windows and freeze periods, maintain rollback procedures, and produce release notes and deployment records that stand up to audit. Accountable for a 90% first-time deployment success standard.
  • CI/CD Engineering: Mature the existing GitHub Actions pipeline into a fully automated, consistently gated process: close remaining manual steps, standardise branching and pull request gates, enforce automated test execution and code coverage thresholds for staging and production promotion, and integrate static analysis. Establish a documented, repeatable promotion path in place of per-release improvisation.
  • Environment and Org Management: Own the sandbox strategy: refresh cadence, data seeding, metadata drift detection, and environment-specific configuration. Remove environment coupling from deployable metadata, including hardcoded record IDs, org-specific endpoints, and test scaffolding that should not ship. Manage named credentials, connected apps, external services, and org limits across the environment chain.
  • Salesforce Administration: Perform hands-on administration: users, profiles, permission sets and permission set groups, role hierarchy, sharing model, field-level security, and Experience Cloud guest and authenticated user access. Manage licence allocation, support Service Cloud administration for the help desk function, and maintain configuration documentation. Own Salesforce seasonal release readiness through preview sandbox testing, impact assessment, and remediation planning.
  • Security and Compliance Operations: Operate within FedRAMP constraints on Salesforce Government Cloud. Maintain platform update currency, support security scanning and remediation tracking, and produce the configuration and deployment artifacts required for continuous monitoring and audit response. Support Section 508 verification gates in the release process.
  • DevOps Platform Migration: Lead the planned migration to an enterprise Salesforce DevOps platform (Copado is the current direction). Scope spans tool evaluation support, pipeline and environment topology design, branching and promotion strategy, deployment configuration, automated regression coverage, cutover and parallel-run planning, and the security documentation required before connecting a third-party platform to a Government Cloud org. The migration must be delivered without a release freeze and without regressing deployment success during cutover.
  • Reporting and Documentation: Maintain the DevOps Plan as a contract deliverable. Supply deployment success, build, and environment availability metrics for weekly and monthly status reporting. Track release work in Jira.
  • Agile Participation: Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and Scrum of Scrums. Represent deployment ability and operational risk during backlog refinement so release constraints surface before commitment rather than at the deployment window..
Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering (any discipline), or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • Experience: Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience, including substantial time owning release management or DevOps for a production Salesforce org.
  • Certifications: Salesforce Certified Administrator or Platform Developer I required.
  • CI/CD: Hands-on experience building and operating Git-based Salesforce CI/CD using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, or equivalent, with Salesforce CLI / SFDX, the Metadata API, source-tracked development, automated test execution, and quality gates.
  • Platform: Production deployment experience across Experience Cloud and Service Cloud, or a comparable multi-cloud Salesforce implementation. Working knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, and SOQL sufficient to triage a failed deployment and read a stack trace.
  • Administration: Demonstrated depth in Salesforce security and sharing configuration, including profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and field-level security.
  • Compliance: Must be eligible for Public Trust (Tier 2 / MBI). U.S. citizenship or permanent residency required.
Preferred Expertise

  • Copado, Gearset, Flosum, or AutoRABIT experience, particularly leading a migration from a Git-native pipeline onto one of these platforms.
  • Prior work in a Salesforce Government Cloud environment, including awareness of feature lag, restricted AppExchange availability, and the approval path for connecting external services.
  • OmniStudio deployment experience using IDX Workbench or datapack-based migration.
  • Salesforce Public Sector Solutions, particularly Grants Management, and familiarity with the federal grants lifecycle.
  • MuleSoft Anypoint deployment and CloudHub release management.
  • Deployment and configuration considerations for Agentforce, Data Cloud / Data 360, or Salesforce Headless APIs.
  • Prior delivery on a federal Salesforce contract.
  • SAFe certification or equivalent scaled agile experience.

Flexible work from home options available.

title: Global Advanced Analytics Partner (US)
description:
Make your mark for patients

To strengthen our Global Advanced Analytics team, we are looking for an adaptable, collaborative individual with an intrapreneurial mindset for our Global Advanced Analytics Partner opening. This hybrid role is based in our Atlanta, GA, Raleigh, NC or Boston, MA offices, requiring 40% onsite presence. This role can be hybrid (40% on site precence in Atlanta, Raleigh or Boston).


About the role
You will help to inform on the commercial viability of various assets in development. You will be responsible for making exceptional business impact with the use of secondary data and insights development through advanced analytics methods, enabling an increased use of data and, where applicable, reducing the necessity for building primary data. You will also be responsible for managing and implementing advanced analytics/AI projects to ensure successful delivery. You will oversee the ongoing operations of advanced analytics solutions to ensure that models continue to work and scale them up with additional demand and applications. You will serve as the subject matter expert for Advanced Analytics/AI capabilities in support of business needs within Patient Solutions and Patient Evidence.


Who you’ll work with
You will co-create with Integrated Insights Leads from early asset and late stage (Phase 0-3) teams, Real world evidence teams, Translational Medicine and Bioinformatics, Clinical operations, clinical recruitment, and asset teams, new product planning teams, Commercial teams, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Finance, and IT. Externally, you will work with data and analytics vendors and partners.


What you’ll do

  • Analytics Leadership: Provide clear expertise for opportunities to leverage advanced analytics, especially where they are advantageous to reducing the need for primary data or have high marginal impact

    • address the most compelling business questions, and/or
    • identify new opportunities for patients and UCB through effective visual displays of quantitative and qualitative information
  • Partnership and Collaboration: Be the key strategic partner for functional stakeholders and co-create plans and priorities for data and advanced analytics with them together with the Patient Solutions and Evidence Leads. Ensure tight relationships and collaboration with IT, Data Office, and other Analytics teams using relevant data sources.
  • Team Leadership. Serve as a mentor and guide to more junior data scientists and translators in demonstrating the application of cutting-edge analytics, clear communication and presentation of insights and practical/pragmatic implementation of key recommendations
  • Drive the execution of regional and local data-driven insights research and data analytics plans and priorities
  • Foster a strong data science community with significant business acumen and communication skills across Hubs and Engine and Supervise the conduct of advanced analytics studies in a collaborative manner ensuring that the study methodology is appropriate to deliver reliable results.
  • Improve the team’s partnership with, and impact on, key internal (UCB) and external stakeholders within the specific area of focus by:
    • developing and executing a communication and collaboration plan with key UCB stakeholders
    • increasing personal and the Advanced Analytics team’s knowledge of the business by ensuring that she/he and each team member has direct interaction with patients and/or other external stakeholders
  • Attract, retain, motivate, and develop key talent for the Advanced Analytics team; coach and develop team members
  • Drive deep partnership with the Hub insights team and other “fellow” Engines and insights generating functions (e.g. regional analytics teams) allowing for a joined delivery of cross-functional, deep impactful insights
  • Be a champion for a data-driven, decision-making culture

Interested? For this role we’re looking for the following education, experience and skills

Minimum Experience/Skills Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in quantitative area
  • Minimum of 6-8+ years experience applying predictive modeling techniques such as ML, decision trees, ensemble learning, neural networks etc, and data transformation such as data cleansing and integration, fuzzy matching, etc., is required
  • Minimum of 6-8+ years of experience developing program/project plans and leading programs/projects from initiation to implementation is required
  • At least 6-8 years of experience working with real world data (Claims data, EMR, IQVIA, -omics, etc)
  • Minimum of 6-8+ years of experience with programming and application development using Python or R is preferred

Preferred Experience/Skills:

  • Master/Doctor’s degree in quantitative area
  • Knowledge of pharmaceutical industry, ideally specialty pharma and biologic treatments
  • Deep expertise in leveraging data science methodologies within the Research and Development and Clinical trials sphere of the pharmaceutical industry. The Go-to-Market domain encompasses the commercial, medical, and market access facets of the business
  • Expertise in analyzing a range of large, secondary transactional databases, unstructured data or other computationally difficult challenges
  • You are a structured problem solver
  • Possess an 80/20 mindset to push for fast model iterations
  • Interpret model results and identify potential model errors (e.g., overfitting, model bias, correlation vs causation)
  • Global role, so willingness and flexibility to work across geographies / time zones (sometimes outside of core hours)

This is not simply a driving, delivery, or vehicle-coordination position. We are looking for someone who will serve as the central source of information and accountability for the entire fleet and take responsibility for each vehicle’s safety, presentation, availability, operating cost, rental performance, and long-term condition.

The right candidate will be equally comfortable inspecting tires, assisting a luxury guest, negotiating with a repair shop, managing an insurance claim, organizing vehicle records, and identifying opportunities to improve rental revenue.

Primary Responsibilities

- Maintain a complete and current inventory and digital record for every Drive Awhile and Stay Awhile vehicle.
- Track each vehicle’s location, mileage, condition, keys, equipment, operating costs, service history, claims, rental activity, and value.
- Establish and manage preventative maintenance and inspection schedules.
- Inspect tires, tread depth, tire pressure, brakes, fluids, batteries, warning lights, windshields, interiors, exteriors, and general performance.
- Identify mechanical, cosmetic, and safety issues before they cause guest problems or unnecessary downtime.
- Coordinate routine service, mechanical repairs, detailing, bodywork, wheel repair, dent removal, windshield replacement, and cosmetic restoration.
- Coordinate vehicle deliveries, pickups, returns, exchanges, cleaning, refueling, and charging.
- Perform and document pre-rental and post-rental inspections, including photographs, mileage, fuel or charge level, existing damage, new damage, and missing equipment.
- Communicate professionally with guests before, during, and after rentals.
- Coordinate roadside assistance, towing, replacement vehicles, and urgent vehicle solutions.
- Ensure all Stay Awhile vans remain clean, organized, safe, properly maintained, and representative of the company’s brand.
- Manage relationships with mechanics, dealerships, body shops, detailers, tire shops, transporters, towing companies, and specialty automotive vendors.
- Obtain and compare estimates, negotiate pricing and completion dates, monitor repairs, and inspect completed work.
- Maintain vendor contracts and track vendor pricing, warranties, quality, and turnaround times.
- Manage DMV registrations, renewals, smog requirements, insurance documentation, warranties, and manufacturer recalls.
- Report accidents and damage promptly and manage insurance claims through resolution.
- Administer fuel and charging cards and investigate unusual or unauthorized charges.
- Manage toll accounts, parking tickets, moving violations, camera citations, and other vehicle-related penalties.
- Determine whether charges are attributable to a guest, employee, or the company and coordinate reimbursement or payment.
- Implement and maintain fleet-management software as the central source of truth for the fleet.
- Monitor rental availability, booking demand, pricing, utilization, revenue, downtime, expenses, and profitability by vehicle.
- Recommend pricing adjustments and strategies for underperforming or aging vehicles.
- Prepare a concise weekly fleet report covering the location, condition, availability, maintenance, claims, expenses, utilization, and performance of every vehicle.
- Recommend when a vehicle should be repaired, repositioned, replaced, or sold.

Required Qualifications

- At least three years of experience in automotive fleet operations, luxury car rentals, dealership operations, automotive service, transportation, or a related field.
- Strong practical understanding of vehicle maintenance and cosmetic condition.
- Experience coordinating repairs and managing automotive vendors.
- Exceptional organization, documentation, and follow-through.
- Ability to manage multiple vehicles, reservations, repairs, vendors, and deadlines simultaneously.
- Professional written and verbal communication skills.
- Confidence working directly with luxury clientele.
- Strong judgment and the ability to solve problems without constant supervision.
- Experience using spreadsheets, scheduling systems, inspection applications, photographs, and reporting tools.
- Valid California driver’s license and a clean driving record.
- Ability to safely operate luxury, performance, electric, oversized, and commercial-style passenger vehicles.
- Availability for occasional evenings, weekends, and urgent vehicle situations.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing luxury, exotic, or high-performance vehicles.
- Experience with Turo or another vehicle-rental platform.
- Rental pricing or revenue-management experience.
- Experience processing automobile insurance claims.
- Familiarity with registrations, warranties, recalls, toll systems, and citation administration.
- Experience implementing or maintaining fleet-management software.
- Knowledge of electric vehicles and charging systems.
- Existing relationships with Los Angeles automotive vendors.
- Hospitality, concierge, or high-end customer-service experience.

Performance Bonus Measures

Bonus eligibility may be based on:

- Fleet availability and vehicle utilization
- Rental revenue and profitability
- Reduction in preventable downtime
- Maintenance and repair-cost control
- Timely completion of registrations, recalls, and warranty work
- Accurate inspections and recordkeeping
- Guest satisfaction
- Reduction in preventable damage and late fees
- Timely recovery of guest-responsible damage, tolls, fuel charges, and citations
- Cleanliness and presentation of all company vehicles
- Quality and timeliness of weekly fleet reporting

To Apply

Please submit a résumé and a brief response addressing:

1. Your experience managing vehicles, rentals, or automotive vendors.
2. The types of vehicles you have worked with.
3. An example of a vehicle-related problem you identified and resolved.
4. Your experience with insurance claims, registrations, warranties, recalls, tolls, or citations.
5. Your experience with rental pricing, fleet software, reporting, or luxury clientele.

title: Stagiair(e) Customer Loyalty
description:
Hoe stimuleren we klanten om vaker te bestellen, meer af te nemen en langdurig aan ons verbonden te blijven? Tijdens deze afstudeerstage ga je aan de slag met een uitdagend strategisch en commercieel vraagstuk: hoe zetten we staffelkortingen slim in om klantloyaliteit te versterken én commerciële groei te realiseren?

Je duikt in onze data, ontdekt commerciële kansen en vertaalt jouw inzichten naar een concreet advies. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Analyseren van de huidige staffelkortingen: welke kortingsstructuren hanteren we en hoe zijn deze opgebouwd?

  • Inzicht krijgen in klantgedrag: wat is het effect van staffelkortingen op bestel frequentie, ordergrootte en klantloyaliteit?

  • Onderzoeken van omzet en marge: welke kortingen leveren daadwerkelijk commerciële groei op en wat betekenen ze voor ons rendement?

  • Identificeren van commerciële kansen: waar kunnen we klanten stimuleren om vaker te bestellen of grotere volumes af te nemen?

  • Segmenteren van klanten: welke kortingsstrategie past het beste bij de behoeften en het gedrag van verschillende klantgroepen?

  • Ontwikkelen van een concreet advies: hoe kunnen we onze staffelkortingen optimaliseren, zowel op totaalniveau als per klantsegment?

Jouw uitdaging? Een slimme en onderbouwde kortingsstrategie ontwikkelen die klantloyaliteit vergroot, commerciële kansen benut en zorgt voor een gezonde balans tussen omzetgroei en rendement.

Zo combineer je data-analyse met commercieel inzicht en lever je een concrete bijdrage aan onze bedrijfsresultaten. Een mooie kans om jouw analytische talent in te zetten voor een vraagstuk met échte impact!

  • Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in een commerciële richting

  • Jij houdt van analyseren en cijfers

  • Je zoekt een afstudeerstage van minimaal 4 maanden

Wat wij jou te bieden hebben

  • En last but not least: je krijgt 20% korting op al onze producten

Onze organisatie en het team

Heuschen & Schrouff is de toonaangevende importeur en distributeur van authentieke Aziatische food- en non foodproducten in Europa. Vanuit Landgraaf (Nederland) vertegenwoordigen we meer dan 65 Aziatische topmerken, zoals YumYum en Flying Goose, en hebben we sterke eigen merkconcepten zoals Golden Turtle for Chefs. Daarnaast bieden we Private Label concepten aan. Dit doen we met een team van meer dan 450 collega’s, 45 vrachtwagens op de weg en een divers klantenbestand van etnische toko’s en groothandels tot retail, foodservice en industrie. Ook hebben wij ons eigen e-commerce platform.

We zijn een gezond, groeiend bedrijf, gedreven door de stijgende populariteit van onze producten. Die groei vraagt om slimme keuzes en efficiëntere processen – en daar kun jij actief aan bijdragen. Bij ons kom je niet terecht in een wereld vol regels of bureaucratische structuren. Integendeel: we waarderen frisse ideeën, eigen initiatief en innovatie. Jij krijgt alle ruimte om mee te denken én mee te bouwen aan de toekomst.

De afdeling Inside Sales Ethnic staat dagelijks in contact met een van onze belangrijkste klantengroepen: Aziatische supermarkten en groothandels verspreid door heel Europa. Als centraal aanspreekpunt voor deze klanten, wordt er op de afdeling vlot geschakeld in verschillende talen en culturen. title: Quantitative Researcher (CeFi/DeFi Arbitrage)
description:
About the Company and Role

We are hiring a Quantitative Researcher for a proprietary high-frequency trading firm active across CeFi, DeFi, and prediction markets.

The role focuses on finding and monetizing price discrepancies between centralized and decentralized markets.

You will work across the full research cycle, studying market microstructure, identifying inefficiencies, turning them into quantitative hypotheses, backtesting strategies on large datasets, and working with engineers to bring successful ideas into production.

A significant part of the role involves understanding how prices, liquidity, latency, and on-chain mechanics interact across different venues. For this position, DeFi primarily means EVM blockchains and Solana, rather than perpetual DEXs such as Hyperliquid or Lighter.

Location: Vilnius, Lithuania, full-time, office-based.

We are offering:

  • Competitive compensation from €6,000 gross per month, depending on your experience and expertise, plus an uncapped annual performance bonus;
  • Work on quantitative strategies connecting centralized and decentralized markets;
  • Access to large volumes of market and on-chain data;
  • Close collaboration with experienced quantitative researchers and software engineers;
  • A high level of ownership across research, strategy development, and live performance;
  • Private health insurance;
  • Regular team events, sports, chess tournaments, and game nights.

What kind of qualifications we are looking for:

  • Strong foundation in mathematics and statistics, including probability, statistical modeling, and time-series analysis;
  • Fluency in Python for quantitative research and data analysis;
  • Strong interest in market microstructure and how prices form across different trading venues;
  • Understanding of DeFi on EVM blockchains and/or Solana;
  • Comfort using LLMs as part of research and coding workflows;
  • Rigorous, data-driven approach to developing and testing trading ideas.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify inefficiencies in market microstructure and turn them into tradable ideas;
  • Formalize research ideas as quantitative strategies and backtest them on large datasets;
  • Work with engineers to deploy strategies and track their live performance;
  • Analyze and reduce latency across exchanges, blockchains, and internal infrastructure;
  • Reverse-engineer competitors' strategies and investigate potential sources of edge;
  • Document and present research findings so the wider team can build on them.

Nice-to-have Requirements:

  • Experience backtesting trading strategies;
  • Competitive mathematics, programming, or Kaggle background;
  • Understanding of stochastic processes, including stochastic calculus or point processes;
  • Experience with distributed systems and low-latency communication;
  • Familiarity with DeFi mechanics, including AMMs, on-chain data, gas, block dynamics, and MEV;
  • Ability to write production-grade code.


If you want to research real market inefficiencies across CeFi and DeFi and take ideas from initial analysis through to live trading, we would like to hear from you. Apply via our website.

title: Sr Security Technologist - Human Risk Management
description:
About the Role

Uber’s Human Risk Management (HRM) team helps people recognize and reduce security risk through training, communications, and behavior change.

As a Senior Security Technologist within Engineering Security, you will build and run Uber’s security learning and awareness program. Using an established annual communications calendar and prioritized threat themes, you will develop a risk-based curriculum, prepare campaigns ahead of schedule, and tailor content to the audiences who need it.

This role combines security expertise with hands-on instructional design and adult learning experience. You will define measurable learning objectives, create effective training, and use data to assess whether it changes behavior. You will also identify when a control, process, or tooling change would address risk more effectively than awareness.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the security awareness curriculum, mapping risk topics to audiences, delivery formats, schedules, and module dependencies.
  • Develop complete training modules, including scripts, storyboards, interactive content, and assessments tied to measurable learning objectives. Maintain an assessment bank with documented answers and rationale.
  • Create targeted content for elevated-risk audiences, including engineering, finance, executive support, and new joiners.
  • Produce accessible, localization-ready content that meets Uber’s standards. Package modules for Uber’s learning platform, using formats such as SCORM or xAPI, and validate completion and score reporting.
  • Deliver campaigns ahead of the annual communications calendar, adapting content for email, Slack, intranet, digital signage, manager talking points, and short-form video.
  • Tailor messaging for technical and non-technical audiences while maintaining a consistent narrative. Own reusable message libraries, style and tone guides, and campaign templates.
  • Conduct structured stakeholder interviews to understand role-based risks, control friction, misconceptions, and effective communication channels. Maintain audience and threat-to-message maps to connect content to risks and identify coverage gaps.
  • Identify risks that require changes to controls, processes, or tooling, and route findings to the responsible teams.
  • Measure engagement, completion, assessment performance, and behavioral outcomes. Connect results to signals from phishing simulations, identity, endpoint, and security reporting systems to improve the program and inform executive reporting.
  • Partner with Security, Communications, Learning and Development, People, and business teams to reflect policies, incidents, and emerging threats in program content.
  • Evaluate and adapt licensed third-party content for Uber where rights permit.
  • Use approved AI tools to accelerate content development, assessments, audience variants, localization preparation, and analysis.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Education, Communications, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in security awareness, human risk management, instructional design, or learning and development, with ownership of an enterprise-scale training or awareness program.
  • Hands-on instructional design and adult learning experience, including measurable learning objectives, aligned assessments, and finished content such as scripts, storyboards, and e-learning interactions.
  • Internal communications experience, with the ability to write clearly for technical and non-technical audiences and communicate results to security leadership.
  • Working knowledge of security awareness and human risk management, including phishing, social engineering, credential handling, data handling, and insider risk.
  • Experience with learning management systems and content packaging standards such as SCORM or xAPI.
  • Experience conducting structured stakeholder interviews and translating findings into documented audience needs and content requirements.
  • Experience using engagement, completion, or assessment data to improve content.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted content development and analysis.
  • Ability to work independently, manage a production calendar, and adapt to changing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience running a security awareness or human risk program in a large, decentralized engineering or technology organization.
  • Experience with phishing simulation platforms, human risk scoring, or behavioral security analytics.
  • Experience with accessibility standards such as WCAG 2.1 AA and preparing content for localization.
  • Experience authoring or maintaining security policies, standards, and procedures aligned with recognized control frameworks.
  • Experience managing editorial operations, including style guides and message libraries, or producing video, short-form content, and digital signage.
  • Scripting or automation experience, such as Python, to process learning data, generate content variants, or integrate systems.
  • Security certifications such as SSAP or Security+, or learning credentials such as CPTD or certifications from ATD.
  • Ability to balance program delivery with long-term strategy.

Why Uber?

You will own a program with company-wide reach, helping employees, contractors, and partners make better security decisions. Working across Security, Communications, Learning and Development, Legal, and executive leadership, you will shape how Uber manages human risk at global scale.

We value curiosity, thoughtful problem-solving, collaboration, and continuous learning. We welcome candidates from different backgrounds and industries and encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every qualification.

For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $180,000 per year - USD $200,000 per year.

For Seattle, WA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $180,000 per year - USD $200,000 per year.

For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

title: Refrigeration Engineer | Koeltechniek & Projectengineering
description:
Ontwerp jij koelinstallaties die technisch kloppen op plan én in de praktijk?

Een performant koelproject begint niet bij de montage, maar bij een doordacht concept. Als Refrigeration Engineer vertaal je klantnoden, technische uitdagingen en duurzaamheidsdoelstellingen naar uitvoerbare koeltechnische oplossingen.

Van de eerste conceptkeuze en calculatie tot detailengineering, technische werfopvolging en commissioning: jouw expertise vormt de technische rode draad doorheen het volledige project. Geen pure salesrol en geen functie die enkel achter een scherm plaatsvindt, wel een sterke combinatie van engineering, technisch-commercieel inzicht en praktijkgerichte projectbegeleiding.

De focus? Commerciële en industriële koeling met onder meer CO₂, propaan/R290, hydroloop, chillers en conventionele koeloplossingen.

Hoe ziet jouw rol eruit?

Van klantvraag naar sterk koelconcept

  • Klantnoden, lastenboeken, koelmeubel- en celconfiguraties analyseren

  • Passende koelconcepten vergelijken op technisch, energetisch, operationeel en economisch vlak

  • Technische specificaties, voorontwerpen en conceptnota’s uitwerken ter ondersteuning van offertes

  • Samenwerken met Sales om technische keuzes helder en overtuigend te onderbouwen

Calculatie en offerte-engineering

  • Koelvermogens, componenten, materialen en hoeveelheden selecteren en berekenen

  • Technische risico’s, uitvoeringsuitdagingen en mogelijke optimalisaties scherp inschatten

  • Kostprijzen en technische offertedossiers opbouwen

  • Scope, aannames en aandachtspunten correct overdragen wanneer een project wordt toegewezen

Detailengineering die werkt op de werf

  • Goedgekeurde koelconcepten uitwerken tot concrete uitvoeringsdossiers

  • Leidingtracés, legplannen, materiaallijsten en technische interfaces voorbereiden

  • Afstemmen met E&I over regelprincipes, meetpunten, veiligheidsketens, alarmen en monitoring

  • Rekening houden met onderhoudstoegankelijkheid, koudemiddelrisico’s en de koppeling met elektrische, bouwkundige en HVAC-installaties

Technische ondersteuning tijdens realisatie

  • Projectleiders, monteurs en onderaannemers ondersteunen bij technische kick-offs en kritische uitvoeringsvragen

  • Technische afwijkingen, RFIs en wijzigingsvoorstellen inhoudelijk beoordelen

  • Mee bepalen welke controles en acceptatiecriteria nodig zijn voor testen, opstart en commissioning

  • Zorgen voor een sterke technische overdracht naar Service

Kwaliteit en innovatie

  • Herbruikbare ontwerpprincipes, selecties en calculatienormen helpen standaardiseren

  • Ontwikkelingen rond koudemiddelen, energieoptimalisatie en regelgeving opvolgen

  • Lessons learned uit offertes, uitvoering en opstart vertalen naar betere ontwerpen en duidelijke kennisdeling

Wie ben jij?

Een engineer die verder kijkt dan een theoretisch correct ontwerp. Technische diepgang, economisch inzicht en voeling met de werf vormen voor jou één geheel.

Sterk in koeltechniek

  • Bachelor- of masterdiploma in koeltechniek, elektromechanica, energietechnologie, HVAC of gelijkwaardige ervaring

  • Ervaring met commerciële of industriële koelinstallaties

  • Kennis van CO₂, R290/propaan, hydroloop, chillers, DX-systemen, koelmeubels en koelcellen is een sterke troef

  • Inzicht in koelbelasting, leidingdimensionering, componentselecties, hydraulica en energieprestaties

  • Kennis van relevante normen en regelgeving, zoals EN 378, PED en F-gassen

Van concept tot uitvoering

  • Interesse in zowel calculatie en conceptvorming als detailengineering en technische projectbegeleiding

  • Praktijkinzicht in werfopvolging, opstart en commissioning

  • Ervaring met AutoCAD, Revit of gelijkaardige ontwerptools is mooi meegenomen

  • Affiniteit met regeltechniek, E&I, GBS en monitoring vormt een extra troef

  • Vlotte omgang met technische dossiers en ERP-systemen; ervaring met Business Central is een plus

Duidelijk en verbindend

  • Heldere communicatie met Sales, projectleiding, uitvoering, leveranciers en Service

  • Sterk Nederlands, een goede basis Frans en functioneel Engels

  • Analytisch, nauwkeurig en hands-on

  • Ownership nemen over technische deliverables en risico’s tijdig zichtbaar maken

Medior ervaring is het richtniveau voor deze functie. Een senior profiel krijgt vanzelfsprekend ruimte om technische kennis verder uit te bouwen en te delen binnen het team.

Een ambitieus groeiverhaal

Je krijgt een contract van onbepaalde duur binnen een innovatieve en snelgroeiende speler in de HVAC-sector.

Carrièremogelijkheden

We groeien en jij kan meegroeien. Nieuwe verantwoordelijkheden en kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen liggen voor je klaar.

Sterk teamgevoel

Onze C-Team waarden zijn ons DNA: Connected, Target driven, Engagement, Accountability en Mastery. Je komt terecht in een hecht team waar collegialiteit en vakmanschap centraal staan.

Een open en mensgerichte cultuur

Acquisition Manager – SBA & Small Business Acquisitions

Base Salary: $115,000–$125,000 + Significant Acquisition Bonuses

This role offers meaningful earning potential beyond the base salary. The successful candidate will be eligible for substantial performance-based bonuses tied to completed acquisitions, deal quality, capital structure, and the long-term value created for the company.

Stay Awhile Villas is building an acquisition platform focused on acquiring hospitality, service, and other cash-flowing businesses. We are seeking an experienced acquisition professional who can source opportunities, evaluate businesses, negotiate creative transactions, and help lead deals from initial outreach through closing.

This is not a traditional salaried acquisitions position. You will work directly with executive leadership, have significant influence over acquisition strategy, and participate financially in the value you help create.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source and identify attractive acquisition opportunities through direct outreach, brokers, referral partners, and proprietary channels.
  • Build trusted relationships with business owners, brokers, lenders, and industry partners.
  • Review financial statements, tax returns, operating reports, and supporting documentation.
  • Build financial models and complete detailed business valuations and underwriting.
  • Evaluate acquisition risks, operational opportunities, growth potential, and expected returns.
  • Structure transactions using conventional financing, SBA financing, seller financing, earnouts, and other creative structures.
  • Prepare clear investment recommendations for executive leadership.
  • Negotiate purchase price, terms, financing structure, and other key transaction points.
  • Coordinate due diligence with legal, accounting, lending, insurance, and operational teams.
  • Support transactions from initial outreach through closing and post-acquisition transition.
  • Help develop the company’s long-term acquisition pipeline and investment strategy.
Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field.
  • MBA or advanced financial education is a plus.
  • Experience in business acquisitions, M&A, corporate development, private equity, investment banking, business brokerage, SBA lending, or a closely related field.
  • Strong financial modeling, valuation, and underwriting skills.
  • Ability to evaluate financial statements and identify business, financial, and operational risks.
  • Understanding of SBA lending and small-business transaction structures is strongly preferred.
  • Excellent negotiation and relationship-building abilities.
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work independently.
  • High level of professionalism, integrity, and discretion.
Successful Candidates Will

  • Consistently identify high-quality acquisition opportunities.
  • Build trusted relationships with business owners and referral partners.
  • Present well-researched and financially sound investment opportunities.
  • Structure creative transactions that preserve capital and maximize long-term value.
  • Support successful acquisitions from initial outreach through closing.
  • Contribute meaningfully to the long-term growth of Stay Awhile Villas and its affiliated companies.
Compensation & Benefits

  • Base salary of $115,000–$125,000, depending on experience.
  • Significant performance-based acquisition bonuses with the potential to materially increase total annual compensation.
  • Bonuses will be based on completed transactions, deal quality, financial structure, and the overall value created for the company.
  • Direct access to executive leadership and involvement in high-impact strategic decisions.
  • Long-term career growth within an expanding acquisition platform.
  • Paid vacation and holidays.
  • Health insurance.
  • 401(k).
  • Additional benefits based on experience.
Why This Opportunity Is Different

title: Quantitative Researcher (Atomic Arbitrage)
description:
About the Company and Role:

We are hiring a Quantitative Researcher for an algorithmic digital asset trading firm operating across CeFi, DeFi, and prediction markets.

The role is focused on understanding what happens on-chain, reconstructing blockchain topology, analyzing executed atomic arbitrage transactions, studying competitors, and identifying the signals behind profitable opportunities.

You will work across the research cycle, from generating and testing hypotheses to collaborating with engineers on strategy deployment and monitoring live performance. A key part of the role is understanding where other market participants gain their edge and turning those findings into actionable research and trading ideas.

The team brings together 50+ Quantitative Researchers and Software Engineers who actively share data, findings, and approaches across different trading areas.

Location: Vilnius, Lithuania, full-time, office-based.

We are offering:

  • Competitive compensation from €6,000 gross per month, depending on your experience and expertise, plus an uncapped annual performance bonus;
  • Work on complex blockchain data and atomic arbitrage problems in a highly competitive trading environment;
  • Close collaboration with experienced quantitative researchers and software engineers;
  • A high level of ownership, with the opportunity to gradually take responsibility for the full research and strategy cycle;
  • Private health insurance;
  • Regular team events, sports, chess tournaments, and game nights.

What kind of qualifications we are looking for:

  • Strong foundation in mathematics, statistics, physics, or another quantitative field;
  • Rigorous, data-driven approach to research and hypothesis testing;
  • Strong motivation to understand why an opportunity exists and what creates an edge;
  • Curiosity about the engineering side of quantitative trading and how data is collected and processed;
  • Interest in networking internals, including TCP stack and HTTP requests.

Responsibilities:

  • Reverse-engineer blockchain topology and analyze on-chain activity;
  • Index and analyze executed atomic arbitrage transactions;
  • Generate hypotheses about competitors' strategies and test them against data;
  • Identify important market and infrastructure signals and maintain monitoring around them;
  • Work with engineers to deploy strategies and monitor their live performance;
  • Document and present research findings so other researchers can build on them;
  • Identify opportunities for collaboration across internal teams;
  • Support the evaluation of opportunities involving external teams.

Nice-to-have Requirements:

  • Prior trading experience;
  • Competitive mathematics or programming background;
  • Ability to write production-grade code;
  • Experience with statistical modeling, time-series analysis, or backtesting;
  • Experience with distributed systems, particularly low-latency communication.


If you enjoy digging into blockchain data, understanding how competitors build their edge, and turning research into live trading strategies, we would like to hear from you. Apply via our website.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
About Dash Technologies

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, USA, Dash Technologies Inc. is a healthcare-focused technology company with a global delivery center in Ahmedabad, India. For more than 15 years, Dash has partnered with healthcare and MedTech organizations to design and engineer digital health solutions spanning Medical IoT, device and system integration, connected applications, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data analytics. Dash combines strong engineering capabilities with practical execution to advance healthcare’s digital transformation and improve care delivery.

The Opportunity

Dash Technologies is seeking an experienced Manual Software Tester / QA Engineer to support software testing and quality assurance for a Medical Device Software product being built from scratch.
You will be responsible for developing and executing test cases, identifying and tracking defects, supporting verification and validation activities, and ensuring high-quality software releases.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role focused primarily on manual testing. Experience with test automation is desirable but optional.

What You’ll Do

Manual Software Testing

  • Develop, review, and maintain test cases, test scenarios, test scripts, and test data.
  • Execute functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, and user acceptance testing.
  • Analyze requirements and create comprehensive test scenarios covering positive, negative, boundary, and edge cases.
  • Identify, document, and track software defects through resolution using bug-tracking tools.
  • Perform retesting and regression testing after defect fixes and software changes.
  • Review test results and provide clear testing status and release-readiness updates.
  • Validate software functionality across different environments, configurations, and supported platforms.
  • Participate in release testing and ensure identified issues are appropriately addressed before release.

Requirements and Test Coverage

  • Review business, functional, and technical requirements to ensure they are testable and clearly understood.
  • Identify gaps, ambiguities, dependencies, and potential risks in requirements.
  • Define acceptance criteria and contribute to backlog refinement.
  • Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, defects, and test results where required.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to clarify expected behavior and acceptance criteria.

Quality Assurance

  • Contribute to test planning and overall QA strategy for the product.
  • Maintain organized and accurate testing documentation and records.
  • Ensure testing activities are performed consistently across development cycles.
  • Participate in defect triage, root cause discussions, and quality reviews.
  • Communicate testing progress, risks, blockers, and quality concerns to relevant stakeholders.
  • Support continuous improvement of testing processes and practices.

Agile Testing

  • Work closely with Agile development teams throughout the sprint lifecycle.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Perform testing within development sprints rather than only at the end of the development cycle.
  • Collaborate with developers to reproduce, investigate, and resolve defects.
  • Ensure acceptance criteria are adequately covered before stories are considered complete.
  • Support appropriate quality gates before software releases.

Test Automation — Optional

  • Experience with test automation is an advantage but is not mandatory.
  • Contribute to identifying suitable test cases for automation.
  • Work with automation engineers or developers to improve automated test coverage.
  • Basic experience with automation tools or frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar is desirable.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD-based automated testing is a plus.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with product managers and business analysts to understand requirements and expected outcomes.
  • Work closely with software developers to investigate and resolve defects.
  • Collaborate with other QA team members to improve test coverage and testing practices.
  • Communicate testing status, defects, risks, and blockers clearly to project stakeholders.
  • Participate in product demonstrations and reviews to understand new functionality.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • At least 3–5 years of experience in software testing or quality assurance.
  • Strong hands-on experience in manual software testing.
  • Experience developing and executing test cases, test scenarios, test scripts, and test plans.
  • Experience performing functional, regression, integration, system, and exploratory testing.
  • Strong understanding of software testing concepts and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Experience identifying, documenting, and tracking defects using tools such as Jira or similar platforms.
  • Experience working with Agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.
  • Experience with test management tools such as Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, QATouch, or similar platforms.

Bonus Points

  • Experience testing Medical Device Software, Healthcare Software, or MedTech products.
  • Experience working on products developed from scratch.
  • Experience testing web applications, mobile applications, APIs, or integrated systems.
  • Basic knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or similar.
  • Basic SQL/database testing experience.
  • Experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, or similar.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.
  • Experience with performance, usability, compatibility, or security testing.
