Salesforce Developer (Junior, Mid-Level, and Senior)
Stealth Solutions | Remote (U.S.), Eastern Time hours | Federal

About the Role

Stealth Solutions is a federal systems integrator delivering Salesforce solutions for government clients. We are hiring several Salesforce Developers at the junior, mid, and senior levels to design, build, test, and deploy secure, scalable solutions on the Salesforce platform. The right candidates write clean, well-tested Apex and Lightning Web Components, know when Flow is a better answer than code, and work carefully in an environment where security controls, client review, and accuracy matter.

This is a fully remote position. Working hours are 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, regardless of where in the U.S. you live.

The responsibilities and qualifications below apply to all levels unless noted. The Levels section describes what differs.

Levels

Junior Developer
  • 1+ year of hands-on Salesforce development, which may include internships, apprenticeships, or substantial project work
  • Builds well-defined user stories under the guidance of a senior developer
  • Writes Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, and test classes to the team’s standards
  • Learns the team’s source control, review, and deployment process
  • Earning the Salesforce Certified Platform Developer certification is an expected development milestone in this role
Mid-Level Developer
  • 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce development, including code you wrote that was deployed to production
  • Owns stories from technical design through deployment with minimal supervision
  • Builds moderately complex features, integrations, and data migration components
  • Participates actively in code reviews and helps junior developers through them
Senior Developer
  • 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce development, including leading technical delivery on at least one production implementation
  • Leads technical design for complex features in partnership with the technical architect
  • Sets and enforces coding, testing, and security standards through code review
  • Mentors junior and mid-level developers
  • Plans deployments and designs integration and data migration approaches
Required Qualifications
  • U.S. Citizenship is required due to federal contract requirements
  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance
  • Candidate must reside in the U.S., be authorized to work in the U.S., and all work must be performed in the U.S.
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Hands-on Salesforce development experience appropriate to the level (see Levels)
  • Strong understanding of core Salesforce architecture, object model, and security model
  • Hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, and integrations
  • Agile development experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills
  • Ability to work as part of a distributed, cross-functional team, and to work independently at the mid and senior levels
Required Certifications
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer (formerly Platform Developer I): required at hire for mid-level and senior candidates; junior candidates must earn it within six months of their start date
Preferred Qualifications
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II (strongly preferred for senior candidates)
  • Salesforce Administrator or Platform App Builder certification
  • Salesforce Certified OmniStudio Developer or Salesforce Certified OmniStudio Consultant
  • Experience working with Salesforce Public Sector Solutions
  • Experience with version control (e.g., Git) and CI/CD processes
  • Familiarity with Experience Cloud development and digital experiences
  • Prior experience supporting government or public sector clients
  • Willingness to maintain and earn new Salesforce certifications as needed

This is a remote position.

title: Product Manager – Operations Systems (m/f/x)
description:
Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet?

We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste.

Our global team of 500 drives things forward collaboratively, takes personal responsibility, values constructive critical thinking, and is dedicated to serving our customers and planet.

The Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product team and own the internal, backend-heavy products behind our operations.

Every item rebuy sells has been through our hands. Before a pre-owned book, DVD, or game reaches a customer, it has been bought in, received, identified, tested, graded, stored, picked, packed, and shipped. The systems that run this flow are the focus of this team, and the users are the hundreds of colleagues in our operations teams.


You will own the tools and services behind inbound processing, grading and quality control, fulfillment, and returns. Your users are warehouse operators, graders, pickers, and operations leads. Your customers are, in the end, every rebuy buyer and seller who relies on the condition and delivery promise we make.

For this role we need someone who is genuinely detail-oriented, who reads the data before forming an opinion, who understands systems and data flows end-to-end, and who can translate operational reality into precise requirements and measurable outcomes.

As a Product Manager you work hand in hand with operations leadership, team leads, engineering, and data to deliver measurable efficiency and quality improvements. You will spend time on the floor with the people who use your products, translate their goals and constraints into a roadmap you own, build the business case with unit economics together with operations and finance, and negotiate scope and timing with engineering. Improvements are co-created with the people who run the operation, not handed to them.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive domain product roadmap: Translate ops strategy (throughput, unit cost, quality, lead time) into a 6–12 month roadmap with the Strategy Manager and Ops Product Lead. Make and document trade-off decisions with ops leaders

  • Understand operational reality: Spend time at the warehouse mapping processes and data flows end-to-end to uncover system gaps and unmet needs early

  • Drive data-backed decisions: Analyze KPIs, pull data, avoid measurement traps, and connect feature changes to unit economics improvements

  • Write precise requirements: Specify business rules, edge cases, data models, state transitions, integrations, and failure modes for engineering

  • Ship iteratively without disruption: Sequence releases safely using pilots, feature flags, parallel runs, change management, and pre-defined metrics

  • Collaborate across teams: Engage in technical discussions and manage scope, time, and urgency trade-offs with tech and ops leads

  • Build stakeholder buy-in: Align ops, CS, tech, finance, and leadership on shared metrics via clear written communication

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in product management, with a focus on backend, internal, workflow, or operational products (for example warehouse, logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, order management, inventory, marketplace operations, fintech back-office, or similar)

  • Hands-on data skills: you can work fluently in an analytics environment, build your own analyses, define metrics rigorously, and spot when a number is misleading

  • Strong attention to detail: experience writing precise specifications covering business rules, edge cases, data models, and failure modes, and catching problems before they reach production

  • Systems thinking: you can map a multi-step operational process and the data flowing through it, identify bottlenecks and inconsistencies, and reason about second-order effects of a change

  • Experience collaborating with engineering on technical decisions, including integrations and data migrations, and negotiating scope and time-to-market trade-offs

  • Clear, structured communication skills, written and verbal, with the ability to build buy-in with operations team leads, engineering, and product leadership

  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to accelerate daily work such as analysis, writing, and prototyping

  • Fluency in English and German

Location:

  • Berlin

  • Hybrid model (Must be willing to have regular presence at our operations sites located in Rudow)


Purpose, a great company culture and incredible benefits - what to expect at rebuy:

  • Work with a friendly team that is passionate about circularity and wants to make the world a little more sustainable, one transaction at a time.

  • Feel comfortable in an environment where independence and new ideas are welcome.

  • Benefit from flat hierarchies and the greatest possible transparency so that things don't take longer than they have to and you always feel well informed.

  • Use employee discounts on , sustainable products at Futurebens, offers for sustainable micro-mobility and massages directly in our office.

  • Have fun at our legendary team and company events.

  • Use our mental health offers as part of a cooperation with Nilo.

  • Take care of your work-life balance with 30 vacation days.

*At rebuy all people are welcome and supported! We would like to talk, regardless of age, disability, national and social origin, skin color, religion, gender identity and sexual orientation. Just be who you are.

title: Quant Trading Developer (DEX/CEX)
description:
Location: Shenzhen

Key responsibilities

  • Trading: Build and trade automated Hyperliquid strategies (arbitrage, liquidations, funding capture) with firm capital, and own the P&L.

  • Trading track record: 3+ years of live quant or systematic prop trading with direct P&L responsibility, running perpetual futures strategies and managing leverage and funding in real time.
  • On-chain node experience: Has built and run a Hyperliquid or other DEX node, and can explain its architecture, bottlenecks and latency trade-offs in depth.
  • On-chain coding: Strong with RPC, WebSocket feeds, transaction signing and smart contracts. Python required; Rust, C++ or Go a strong plus.
  • Deep understanding of perpetuals, funding, leverage, liquidations and on-chain order books.
  • Solid grasp of exchange microstructure (order types, order-book events, rate limits).
  • Bachelor’s or above in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Mathematics or a related quantitative field.

Strongly preferred

  • Low-latency or HFT background (e.g. lock-free structures, ring buffers).

Full-Cycle Senior Architectural Signage Project Manager

Job Description: Full-Cycle Project Management | Architectural Signage, Environmental Graphics & Wayfinding
Location: South Florida (Hybrid – Office, Remote & Jobsite)
Job Type: Full-Time | Senior-Level Position
Reports To: Directly to ownership / senior leadership


About Us
Trademark Sign, LLC is seeking an experienced Full-Cycle Senior Architectural Signage Project Manager to oversee complex, large-scale interior and exterior architectural signage projects.

We are a growing commercial signage company serving developers, general contractors, architects, designers, and national commercial clients. Our projects range from comprehensive architectural signage packages to large-scale exterior signage and specialty custom fabrication.

We are looking for a seasoned professional who understands the architectural signage industry and can independently manage projects from initial estimating and procurement through installation and closeout.

This is a senior-level opportunity for an individual who possesses exceptional technical knowledge, strong financial and organizational skills, and the ability to confidently represent our company with sophisticated commercial clients.


Position Overview
The Senior Architectural Signage Project Manager is responsible for managing complex architectural signage and environmental graphics projects from initial client engagement and estimating through design development, engineering, permitting, production, installation, and final project closeout.

This role serves as the primary point of contact for clients, architects, designers, general contractors, developers, landlords, engineers, fabricators, and installation teams. The ideal candidate has extensive experience managing custom architectural signage programs, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, controlling budgets and schedules, and ensuring projects meet design intent, technical specifications, quality standards, and contractual requirements.

The Senior Project Manager is expected to take full ownership of assigned projects, proactively resolve challenges, manage financial performance, and deliver projects safely, on time, and within budget.

Key Responsibilities
1. Client Relations & Project Initiation
  • Serve as the primary client contact throughout the entire project lifecycle.
  • Lead project kickoff meetings and establish scope, deliverables, milestones, budgets, and communication protocols.
  • Review contracts, proposals, architectural drawings, signage schedules, design intent documents, and project specifications.
  • Identify project risks, scope gaps, exclusions, assumptions, and potential change orders.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, architects, interior designers, developers, general contractors, and other project stakeholders.
  • Translate client expectations and design concepts into executable project plans.
2. Estimating, Budgeting & Financial Management
  • Review project requirements and coordinate estimating for materials, fabrication, engineering, permitting, freight, equipment, and installation.
  • Develop and manage project budgets, cost forecasts, schedules of values, billing milestones, and cash flow projections.
  • Monitor labor, material costs, subcontractor expenses, and overall project profitability.
  • Review purchase orders, vendor quotes, subcontractor proposals, and change order requests.
  • Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality, code compliance, or design intent.
  • Prepare and negotiate change orders for revisions, additional scope, unforeseen conditions, and schedule impacts.
  • Track project financial performance, invoicing, collections, retainage, and final reconciliations.
3. Design Development & Technical Coordination
  • Coordinate with graphic designers, environmental graphic designers, architects, engineers, and technical design teams.
  • Manage design development, client presentations, material selections, color samples, finish schedules, and shop drawing approvals.
  • Review signage schedules, elevations, floor plans, mounting details, dimensions, and installation conditions.
  • Coordinate structural engineering, electrical requirements, illumination, power supplies, and attachment methods where applicable.
  • Ensure signage packages align with architectural intent, brand standards, accessibility requirements, and project specifications.
  • Manage design revisions and maintain accurate documentation of approvals and outstanding items.
  • Coordinate prototype development, mockups, samples, and first-article approvals when required.
4. Engineering, Permitting & Code Compliance
  • Coordinate engineering submissions, structural calculations, electrical documentation, and other required technical deliverables.
  • Manage sign permit applications, landlord approvals, municipal reviews, and jurisdictional submissions.
  • Coordinate with local authorities, expediters, engineers, and permit consultants to obtain required approvals.
  • Track permit status, review comments, resubmissions, and approval deadlines.
  • Verify project requirements related to applicable building codes, zoning ordinances, wind-load criteria, electrical codes, accessibility standards, and local sign regulations.
  • Identify compliance issues early and coordinate corrective action with the appropriate design and engineering professionals.
5. Procurement & Vendor Management
  • Develop procurement schedules aligned with approved drawings and project milestones.
  • Source and coordinate specialty materials, sign components, lighting systems, finishes, hardware, and subcontracted services.
  • Issue purchase orders and monitor vendor performance, lead times, quality, and delivery commitments.
  • Coordinate with internal or external fabrication facilities to confirm production readiness.
  • Manage long-lead items and proactively mitigate supply chain delays.
  • Review vendor submittals and material certifications as required by the project.
6. Fabrication & Production Management
  • Oversee the transition from approved design documents to fabrication-ready shop drawings and production packages.
  • Coordinate production schedules with vendors and outsourcing partners.
  • Resolve fabrication discrepancies, field conflicts, material substitutions, and design changes.
  • Ensure fabricated signage complies with approved drawings, specifications, finishes, dimensions, and performance requirements.
7. Construction Coordination & Installation
  • Coordinate site surveys, field measurements, existing-condition verification, and installation planning.
  • Review construction schedules and coordinate signage installation with general contractors, superintendents, electricians, and other trades.
  • Develop installation schedules, manpower plans, equipment requirements, access plans, and delivery sequences.
  • Coordinate cranes, lifts, scaffolding, traffic control, site access, and other specialized installation requirements.
  • Verify site readiness, mounting substrates, blocking, electrical rough-ins, and required permits before mobilization.
  • Lead or participate in pre-installation meetings and resolve field conditions that may affect execution.
  • Monitor installation progress, workmanship, safety compliance, and adherence to approved plans.
  • Coordinate punch lists, deficiencies, corrective work, inspections, and final acceptance.
8. Schedule & Risk Management
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive project schedules from award through closeout.
  • Establish critical milestones for design approvals, engineering, permitting, procurement, fabrication, delivery, and installation.
  • Track dependencies and identify critical-path activities.
  • Provide regular project status updates to clients, leadership, and internal teams.
  • Anticipate schedule risks and implement recovery plans when delays occur.
  • Maintain risk registers, action logs, decision logs, and issue-resolution plans for complex projects.
  • Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously while balancing deadlines, resources, and client priorities.
9. Documentation & Project Controls
  • Maintain organized project files, contracts, drawings, revisions, RFIs, submittals, approvals, purchase orders, and correspondence.
  • Manage requests for information, submittal logs, drawing registers, meeting minutes, and action items.
  • Ensure all project stakeholders are working from the latest approved documents.
  • Maintain accurate records of schedule changes, scope changes, site conditions, and client directives.
  • Prepare progress reports, budget updates, installation reports, and executive summaries.
  • Ensure documentation supports contractual compliance, billing, change management, and closeout requirements.
10. Final Closeout & Client Handover
  • Coordinate final inspections, punch-list completion, deficiency resolution, and client acceptance.
  • Collect warranties, maintenance manuals, as-built drawings, inspection documentation, and closeout packages.
  • Verify completion of contractual deliverables and outstanding financial obligations.
  • Reconcile final project costs, subcontractor invoices, change orders, and retainage.
  • Conduct post-project reviews to identify lessons learned and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Maintain client relationships and support warranty issues, service requests, and future project opportunities.
11. Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Provide leadership and direction to project coordinators, junior project managers, designers, vendors, and installation teams.
  • Coordinate across sales, estimating, design, engineering, procurement, fabrication, accounting, and field operations.
  • Establish accountability for deliverables, deadlines, quality, and communication.
  • Escalate material risks, financial concerns, and client issues to senior leadership when appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, project controls, standard operating procedures, and operational efficiency.
Qualifications & Experience
  • 7–10+ years of project management experience in architectural signage, custom signage fabrication, environmental graphics, wayfinding, or a closely related construction specialty.
  • Demonstrated experience managing the full project lifecycle from estimating and design development through fabrication, installation, and closeout.
  • Experience managing complex commercial, corporate, healthcare, hospitality, retail, multifamily, institutional, or large-scale development projects.
  • Strong understanding of architectural drawings, construction documents, signage schedules, shop drawings, materials, mounting methods, and installation requirements.
  • Experience with permitting, engineering coordination, code compliance, and construction-site logistics.
  • Proven ability to manage project budgets, schedules, contracts, change orders, and profitability.
  • Experience coordinating general contractors, architects, subcontractors, fabricators, and specialty trades.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, negotiation, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project scheduling or project management software.
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings and manage multiple concurrent projects.
  • Willingness to travel to project sites as required.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with large-scale architectural signage packages.
  • Familiarity with illuminated signage, dimensional lettering, monument signs, building identification, interior signage, donor recognition, code signage, and wayfinding systems.
  • Experience with construction management platforms such as Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with CAD drawings, Bluebeam, Adobe Creative Suite workflows, or related design review tools.
  • Experience with AIA-style contracts, subcontract agreements, schedules of values, and construction billing procedures.
  • OSHA safety training or other relevant construction safety credentials.
  • PMP certification or equivalent project management training.
What We Offer
  • Competitive senior-level compensation based on experience and qualifications.
  • Performance-based incentive opportunities tied to project success and profitability.
  • Hybrid work arrangement combining remote work, office collaboration, and jobsite visits.
  • Opportunity to manage significant, high-profile architectural signage projects.
  • Direct involvement with company leadership and major client relationships.
  • Opportunity for professional growth within an expanding organization.
  • A results-oriented environment that values accountability, technical expertise, and independent decision-making.
The Ideal Candidate
We are not looking for someone who simply tracks project schedules or passes information between departments.

We want a professional who can receive a complete set of architectural drawings, identify and quantify the signage scope, develop an accurate project estimate, competitively source the required products, manage the client relationship, and successfully execute the project while protecting company profitability.


Compensation Competitive salary based on experience, certifications, and knowledge.

Apply
If you have extensive architectural signage experience, strong technical and financial skills, and the ability to independently manage sophisticated commercial projects, we would like to hear from you.

title: Salesforce UI/UX Designer
description:
Benefits:
  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
Position Overview

Stealth Solutions is seeking a Salesforce UI/UX Designer to join our federal delivery practice. In this role, you will design human-centered, accessible experiences across both internal Salesforce applications (Lightning Experience, custom Lightning Web Components) and external-facing Digital Experience (Experience Cloud) sites for federal agency clients. You will partner closely with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, and Developers to translate agency requirements into intuitive, standards-compliant designs - from low-fidelity wireframes through high-fidelity, developer-ready mockups.

This role requires fluency in Salesforce's native design language (Salesforce Lightning Design System) as well as the U.S. Web Design System (USWDS), and a strong working knowledge of Section 508 / WCAG accessibility requirements, which are non-negotiable in federal delivery work.

Key Responsibilities

· Design end-to-end user experiences for both internal Salesforce (Lightning Experience) applications and public-facing Digital Experience / Experience Cloud sites
· Create wireframes, user flows, journey maps, and high-fidelity mockups/prototypes (e.g., in Figma) that translate business and user requirements into clear design solutions
· Apply and extend the Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS) to ensure visual and interaction consistency across custom components, page layouts, and Experience Cloud themes
· Apply USWDS components and patterns to public-facing Digital Experience sites to meet federal design and branding standards
· Ensure all designs meet Section 508 and WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA accessibility requirements, and partner with QA/accessibility testers to validate compliance
· Conduct or support user research activities - interviews, usability testing, surveys - and translate findings into personas, requirements, and design iterations
· Facilitate design workshops and reviews with federal agency stakeholders, gathering feedback and driving consensus on design direction
· Partner with Salesforce Administrators, Developers, and Solution Architects to ensure designs are technically feasible within platform constraints (page layouts, dynamic forms, Lightning components, navigation, branding)
· Maintain and evolve a design system / component library to ensure consistency across projects and client engagements
· Document design decisions, style guides, and design specifications for handoff to development teams
· Stay current on Salesforce release features (Lightning, Experience Cloud, Dynamic Forms, etc.) and evolving USWDS/508 guidance

Required Qualifications

· U.S. Citizenship required, with ability to obtain/maintain the clearance level required by the contract
· 3+ years of UI/UX design experience, including demonstrable experience designing for the Salesforce Platform (Lightning Experience and Experience Cloud)
· Strong portfolio showcasing wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups for enterprise or government applications
· Proficiency with design and prototyping tools (Figma required; Adobe XD/Sketch a plus)
· Working knowledge of the Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS)
· Hands-on familiarity with the U.S. Web Design System (USWDS) components and patterns
· Solid understanding of Section 508 requirements and WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA accessibility standards, with experience designing for and validating accessible experiences
· Experience conducting user research, usability testing, and translating findings into actionable design artifacts (personas, journey maps, user stories)
· Strong communication and stakeholder-facilitation skills; comfortable presenting design rationale to both technical and non-technical federal stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

· Salesforce Certified Platform User Experience Designer - strongly preferred
· Additional Salesforce certifications, such as:
o Salesforce Certified Administrator
o Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant
o Salesforce Certified Business Analyst
o Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder
· Prior experience supporting federal or other public-sector clients (civilian agencies, DoD, or state/local government)
· Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies in a consulting environment
· Experience contributing to or maintaining a formal design system/component library
· Front-end fluency (HTML/CSS/basic LWC markup) sufficient to collaborate closely with developers on implementation details.

Flexible work from home options available.
